productTitle: Cow Leather Closed-Toe Mules with Buckle Strap for Everyday Wear
textDesc: Cow leather closed-toe mules with a buckle strap, open heel and flat profile for casual everyday outfits. Unlined upper and cemented construction. Beige and Camel options with size labels 35-45. Cork is the source sole description; individual midsole and ground-contact outsole formulations are not specified. companyFaqDesc: The upper is cow leather with no separate lining. The sole is described as cork; individual midsole and ground-contact outsole layer formulations are not specified. Send detailed material requirements for confirmation before ordering.
Which colours and sizes can I request?
Beige and Camel, with size labels 35-45. Send your colour-size quantities. Current availability and fit measurements are confirmed before order; no unverified US size conversion is provided.

The listed minimum order is 2 pairs. Reference unit prices are USD 17.47 for 2-49 pairs, USD 16.31 for 50-99 pairs and USD 15.14 for 100 pairs or more. Freight, packaging and final order terms are confirmed separately.
How do I confirm fit for my assortment?

Please share the sizes you need and your fit or measurement requirements. Confirm the agreed size labels and product measurements before ordering. No foot-length chart or wider-fit promise has been verified for this style.

Send your sample quantity, logo, colour and packaging requirements. Feasibility, sample charges, minimum quantities and timing are assessed before quotation; customization is not included automatically.
How are dispatch and delivery arranged?

Send your destination, quantities and required date. Colour-size availability, packaging, freight options and dispatch timing are confirmed before order. The listing does not guarantee current stock or a fixed seven-day dispatch period.
